login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Signing in keeps your projects, your progress and your answers with your account. The lab itself works without one.
login.credentialHint: The username your educator gave you. If you run a classroom, use your email address instead.
login.noSignUpBody: You cannot make your own account, and neither can anyone else. Every account starts with an invitation: your educator gives you a username and a short code, and you choose your own password when you redeem it.
login.forgotBody: The lab holds no email address for you, so it cannot send you a reset link. Your educator can give you a fresh code instead.

session.signedOut: You have signed out. The projects on this device are still here.

code.label: Invitation code
code.hint: Six characters. A code never contains the letters O or I, or the digits 0 or 1, so those are easy to tell apart on a whiteboard.
code.tooShort: A code is six characters long.
code.srDescription: Six characters, letters and digits, not case sensitive.

field.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Your educator never sees it and cannot look it up.
field.aliasHint: This is the only name your classmates and your educator see on a list. Pick something you are happy to be called.
field.required: Fill this in to carry on.
field.passwordMismatch: Those two passwords are not the same.

redeem.title: Redeem an invitation
redeem.intro: Your educator gave you a username and a six-character code. Enter both, then pick a password and a display name. The password is yours — nobody else can see it or look it up.
redeem.signInAfterwards: Your account is ready, but signing you in did not work. Try signing in with the username your educator gave you.
redeem.privacy: The lab asks for no email address, no birthday and no real name — not now and not later. Your photos and your trained model never leave this device.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Enter the reset code your educator gave you, then choose a new password. Your display name and all your work stay exactly as they are.
reset.onlyEducator: Only your educator can issue a reset code. The lab holds no email address for you, so there is nothing for it to send a link to — and until you have a code, the whole lab still works without signing in.

refusal.expired: That code has expired. A code lasts {{hours}} hours — ask your educator for a new one.
refusal.used: That code has already been used. Ask your educator for a new one.
refusal.cancelled: That code was cancelled. Ask your educator for a new one.
refusal.invalid: That code is not valid. Check it with whoever gave it to you.
refusal.rateLimited: That is too many tries in one go. Wait an hour and try again, or ask your educator for a new code.
refusal.aliasTaken: Someone in your class already uses that display name. Pick another one.
refusal.aliasLength: Pick a display name between 2 and 24 characters.
refusal.passwordTooShort: Pick a password of at least 8 characters.
refusal.unknown: That did not work, and nothing was changed. Try again.

error.wrongCredentials: That username and password do not go together. Check both and try again.
error.deactivated: This account has been switched off. Ask your educator, or whoever runs the program.
error.unconfigured: This copy of the lab has no account service set up, so there is nothing to sign in to. Everything else works.
error.network: The lab could not reach the account service. Check your connection and try again — the projects on this device work either way.
